# E0516: handler around an effect that belongs to the caller

A call of a function parameter performs your caller's effects, which this `with` would capture. Name the effect in the parameter's row to handle it here.

- Rule: [`handlers.with-pairing`](../../reference/12-effects.md#handlers.with-pairing)
- Reported at: the call.
- Tier: `advanced`, checked in the `analyses` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0516:6
effect Ask {
  fn ask() -> i64
}

fn run(f: fn() -> i64) -> i64 {
  with (handler Ask { fn ask() -> i64 { 1 } }) { f() }
}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
effect Ask {
  fn ask() -> i64
}

fn run(f: fn() -> i64 / Ask) -> i64 {
  with (handler Ask { fn ask() -> i64 { 1 } }) { f() }
}
```
